result.note: Tests the record rice stock, the wheat stock peak and the timing of India's removal of rice export curbs, from official data released in June 2026.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's foodgrain stocks and rice trade, based on official data released in June 2026:
items: As of 1 June 2026, government rice reserves stood at a record level, about 15% higher than a year earlier.
As of 1 June 2026, government wheat stocks reached a ten-year peak.
India removed its last export curbs on rice in March 2025.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Wheat stocks of 53.41 million tonnes were a five-year peak, not a ten-year one, while rice reserves rose 15% to a record 68.43 million tonnes. India, which supplies around 40% of global rice exports, lifted its last curbs in March 2025, and the stocks cushion a below-average 2026 monsoon forecast.
questions.source: Government rice reserves climbed 15% year-on-year to a record 68.43 million tonnes as of 1 June, while wheat stocks reached a five-year peak of 53.41 million tonnes, official data showed on Tuesday.
